info.name: Voice Training API v1 — frontend contract
info.description:
Implemented Voice Training API v1. English product content; Russian integration guide in README.md. Examples are static illustrative data, not real analysis. IDs are opaque UUIDs; authentication uses the HttpOnly guest cookie.
Story focus: choose one saved recorded-take reflection, explicitly attach its immutable version when starting narration, then save a subjective listening check. Older take snapshots remain unchanged; focus is carried into the next day.
Listening decisions: experiment with one change, keep a useful feature, or save an undecided reflection without adopting a new story focus.
Optional E08 listening contrasts: public synthetic audio, unscored listener choice and an explicit immutable selected-boundary snapshot for the next take.
